title: Events can only be enabled via CLI, `worker_send_task_events` is ignored
body:
Template filled out below but this is pretty clear. This line populates Worker.task_events using `either`: https://github.com/celery/celery/blob/04771d65597f62ccf2f9d901c0d1f7c1d0f24d42/celery/worker/worker.py#L377 However, as of version 5, the `task_events` arg is `False` here when the argument is omitted from the command line, not `None`. So `either`, which looks for the first non-`None` value, always returns `False` and ignores the value from `app.conf`. Works as expected in 4.4.7. # Checklist - [x] I have verified that the issue exists against the `master` branch of Celery. - [ ] This has already been asked to the [discussion group](https://groups.google.com/forum/#!forum/celery-users) first. - [x] I have read the relevant section in the [contribution guide](http://docs.celeryproject.org/en/latest/contributing.html#other-bugs) on reporting bugs. - [x] I have checked the [issues list](https://github.com/celery/celery/issues?q=is%3Aissue+label%3A%22Issue+Type%3A+Bug+Report%22+-label%3A%22Category%3A+Documentation%22) for similar or identical bug reports. - [x] I have checked the [pull requests list](https://github.com/celery/celery/pulls?q=is%3Apr+label%3A%22PR+Type%3A+Bugfix%22+-label%3A%22Category%3A+Documentation%22) for existing proposed fixes. - [x] I have checked the [commit log](https://github.com/celery/celery/commits/master) to find out if the bug was already fixed in the master branch. - [x] I have included all related issues and possible duplicate issues in this issue (If there are none, check this box anyway). ## Mandatory Debugging Information - [x] I have included the output of ``celery -A proj report`` in the issue. ## Minimally Reproducible Test Case

Install Celery, save the following in testapp.py ```python from celery import Celery app = Celery('tasks', broker='pyamqp://guest@localhost//') app.conf.worker_send_task_events = True ``` and run `celery -A testapp worker --loglevel=INFO`.

# Expected Behavior In the startup banner, I expect to see `task events: ON` and for events to be sent. # Actual Behavior The startup banner says `task events: OFF (enable -E to monitor tasks in this worker)` and events are not sent.
